# Soni Khimraj Lalji Jewellers

> Family jewellery shop in Ghatkopar West, Mumbai, India, trusted for over 25 years. Sells BIS hallmarked 22K (916) and 18K gold jewellery, diamond jewellery, silver jewellery and articles, bridal Kundan & Polki sets and mangalsutras. Also offers custom / made-to-order jewellery and old gold exchange.

- Address: Shop No 9, Dr. Lakhani Estate, Jivdaya Lane, Ghatkopar West, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400086, India (short walk from Ghatkopar railway station, West side)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 91361 75991
- Hours: Monday to Sunday, 10:00 AM – 9:30 PM
